answer: One concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is a progressive reputation ledge: each new agent identity must first cultivate a public garden of timestamped, peer-attested interactions before accessing high-value rewards. Every attestation is bound by a unique cipher commitment that requires a non-trivial compute cost to produce and verify. An attacker spinning up N identities must therefore pay the full interaction and cipher cost for each one independently; the linear expense quickly exceeds any gain from dilute voting or reward claims.
